costs.apply_rule: every fill is a market order: taker fee on the full traded notional, plus adverse slippage of baseline_slippage_ticks instrument ticks (1 tick = price_increment). No maker fills are assumed anywhere.
costs.baseline_slippage_provenance: research assumption of this round (NOT user-specified); robustness re-measures it at 2 ticks
costs.cost_attrition_grid: cost_attrition_40bps applies 8x the registered taker fee = 40 bps per fill, the registered attrition stress of the original falsification battery
costs.funding: the registered funding series is charged at each settlement inside the episode's exposure interval (rate x position notional at that instant); a negative rate is a CREDIT to a long position and a COST to a short. The no_funding / no_funding_full grids re-measure the same cells with the funding cost zeroed (descriptive), and funding_2x doubles it.
costs.funding_exposure_rule: The position is exposed to every funding settlement whose raw instant lies in the CLOSED interval [entry instant - 1 s, exit instant + 1 s]. A settlement is charged on the position notional at the moment of the charge: the close of the bar that contains it inside the episode, or the episode's exit fill price when it lands at the closing boundary. The sign follows the position. Settlements outside the closed interval are never charged, and the rule assumes no fixed settlement spacing (SOLUSDT's 2022-11 4 h-interval episode is charged settlement by settlement).
costs.funding_immutability: the funding baseline must not be swapped for a modelled series to improve the outcome, nor vice versa
costs.source: canonical instrument metadata (raw binance/usdm/instruments/usdm-perp-instruments.json), read at run time, never hard-coded

bar_labelling.consequence: a bar's bin, a bin's close instant and the bar that first sees the bin's state are all derived by exact integer arithmetic on measured timestamps; no boundary is inferred from a label

measured_at_pre_registration.finding: open_time_ms is the bar START in UTC and the 1h grid is exactly contiguous for all four contracts over the window (41,160 bars each, zero gaps, zero off-grid steps), so the bin membership of a bar is exact: 41,160 / 4 = 10,290 bins per cohort, every bin aligned to a 00:00 UTC 4h boundary and holding exactly 4 base bars. The engine asserts the alignment, the 4-bar completeness and bin_available_bar == bin_last_bar + 1 at run time.

dca_execution_semantics.authorization: Inherited verbatim from the Strategy A/B engine family (the ladder geometry, breakeven-anchored TP and resting invalidation semantics); this round parametrises the four axes and bounds the rail by the signal episode - it does not re-interpret the execution semantics.

engine_semantics.capital_exhaustion: no episode is opened once the realised equity is gone; the guard is re-evaluated after every fill and against the equity the entry fee itself will leave behind
engine_semantics.entry: the OPEN of the first base bar after the fresh signal event, taker fill with adverse slippage; the entry bar must lie inside the evaluated slice or the event is skipped and counted
engine_semantics.intrabar_ordering: deterministic and conservative: a long episode walks the bar LOW first and then the HIGH; a short episode mirrors it (HIGH first). A ladder level below (above) the resting stop of a long (short) can never fill, and a gap through the stop fills at the bar open.
engine_semantics.invalidation: a RESTING stop at running_average_cost x (1 -/+ invalidation_pct), anchored on the same reference as the TP
engine_semantics.non_overlap: one position at a time: an entry event that lands while an episode is open cannot open a second position, and the next episode may only start from a fresh signal at a base bar strictly after the previous flatten bar (no same-bar re-entry); the counters can never be negative
engine_semantics.signal_exit: the record's own exit: an opposite signal while the mark price is strictly better than the running average cost for the position direction flattens every layer reduce-only at the next base bar open; an opposite signal while the position is NOT profitable is blocked and counted (signal_exit_blocked_unprofitable) - this asymmetry is measured by the registered family-level reader, never silently repaired
engine_semantics.sizing: non-compounding fixed-quote basis on the pre-registered starting equity: level k margin = base_quote x size_multiplier^k (k = 0..10); level notional = margin x leverage
engine_semantics.slice_end: a reduce-only flatten of every layer at the last bar close of the evaluated slice
engine_semantics.take_profit: reduce-only full flatten of the whole episode when the bar high/low reaches running_average_cost x (1 +/- breakeven_tp_pct)

dca_execution_semantics.invalidation_anchoring: the resting invalidation is anchored on the running AVERAGE COST, the same reference as the breakeven-anchored TP
dca_execution_semantics.trigger_anchoring: the LADDER is anchored on the INITIAL ENTRY FILL PRICE of the episode
dca_execution_semantics.window_bounded: tranche #1 is the initial entry at the open of the first base bar after the fresh signal event; adverse-price scale-ins follow the ladder while the position is open (level_k price = initial_entry_price x (1 -/+ spacing_pct x k), k = 1..10, so at most 11 routine active levels of the 12-tranche rail); any of the four registered exits flattens every layer exactly once, then the book is FLAT and no layer may be added again before a NEW fresh signal

hypothesis.direction: SIGN of the trained transition row: p_bull > min_signal_probability and p_bull > p_bear -> LONG; p_bear > min_signal_probability and p_bear > p_bull -> SHORT; an exact tie or a row with fewer than 5 observations -> no signal. On a perpetual both legs are tradable, so the registered book is two-sided exactly as the record's buy/sell signal rule states.
hypothesis.mechanism: The record reports the effect as discretised state persistence: "useful sequences" of states with a high probability of preceding a specific bullish or bearish movement, trained from the instrument's own history and read as a directional signal. This round measures whether those transitions survive the registered costs, the four execution stress grids and the card's DCA execution layer.
hypothesis.source_note: the record names eight parameters (price_state_threshold, volume_high_multiplier, volume_low_multiplier, atr_period, sequence_length, min_signal_probability, sl_multiplier, tp_multiplier) and fixes no value for any of them. This round registers three SEARCHED axes (threshold, sequence length, minimum signal probability), five PROJECT pre-registration constants (atr_period 14, volume_sma_period 24, the two volume multipliers, the 5-observation row floor), two SUPERSEDED items (sl_multiplier/tp_multiplier, disclosed above) and the RESEARCH_DEFINED timing/availability contract.
hypothesis.statement: Market behaviour can be discretised into 12 price-momentum (ATR-normalised) x volume-regime states on a completed 4h bar, and short sequences of those states carry non-random transition probabilities to the NEXT state, so a sequence whose empirical transition row is dominated by bullish next-states predicts the immediate direction of the instrument.
hypothesis.test_statistic: the four registered cohorts (BNBUSDT / BTCUSDT / ETHUSDT / SOLUSDT, base grid 1h): the deterministic historical-only winner cell of each cohort is carried unchanged into OOS, the full window, the four execution stress grids and its historical parameter neighbourhood. The family statistic is the COUNT of cohort survivors (0..4), never a cross-cohort median.

parameter_domain.atr_period_status: PROJECT_PRE_REGISTERED_CONSTANT - the record names atr_period and fixes no value; the frozen 14 is a project pre-registration constant (Wilder's standard), fixed before any computation and NOT a searched axis.
parameter_domain.case_definition: a strategy case is (price_state_threshold, sequence_length, min_signal_probability): the ATR-relative price-move threshold that discretises the price state, the number of completed 4h bin states in the decision sequence, and the probability floor a trained transition row must exceed to emit a signal
parameter_domain.entry_timing_status: RESEARCH_DEFINED - the record's backtester executes at the row after the evaluated sequence; the registered entry is the OPEN of the next base bar after a FRESH signal event (the first executable price after the signal is measurable), and the entry_delay_1_bar stress re-measures the whole product one bar later.
parameter_domain.exit_timing_status: RESEARCH_DEFINED - the record's exit is 'opposite signal AND currently profitable' plus ATR-anchored stop/take-profit with intra-bar precision. The registered exit set is the DCA rail TP, the resting invalidation, the record's own profitability-gated opposite-signal flatten at the next base bar open, and the reduce-only slice-end flatten at the last bar close.
parameter_domain.kind: strategy parameter domain (the registered state-case set), a composite axis over (price state threshold, sequence length, minimum signal probability)

markov_contract.atr: Wilder ATR over atr_period = 14 completed bins: TR_i = max(high_i - low_i, |high_i - close_{i-1}|, |low_i - close_{i-1}|); atr_14 = mean(TR_1..TR_14); atr_i = (13 * atr_{i-1} + TR_i) / 14 for i > 14; a bin whose ATR is not positive or whose window is incomplete carries NO state
markov_contract.direction: the record registers both a buy and a sell signal, so the family trades both directions; a position is always opened by a fresh signal and is flattened by one of the four registered exits
markov_contract.entry: the OPEN of the next base bar after the signal event (the first executable price after the signal is measurable)
markov_contract.exit: (1) rail take profit at running_average_cost x (1 +/- breakeven_tp_pct); (2) resting invalidation at running_average_cost x (1 -/+ invalidation_pct); (3) the record's own signal exit: an opposite signal while the position is profitable against its running average cost -> reduce-only flatten of every layer at the next base bar open; (4) slice end -> reduce-only flatten of every layer at the last bar close
markov_contract.lookahead_control: the naive left-edge resample + backward as-of merge of the source would attach a bin's own eventual state to the bars inside that bin; the engine carries a registered structural counter that every attached state was available before the bar it is attached to, and the engine self-check red-proves the naive variant would be detected
markov_contract.matrix: expanding-window point-in-time counts of (sequence -> next state), grown only from transitions whose outcome bin has already completed at the decision bar; no future bar and no future bin can enter the row, which is the record's limitation 'transition-matrix training must remain strictly isolated from the evaluation window' implemented as strict causality
markov_contract.min_row_observations: a sequence whose row carries fewer than 5 observed transitions yields NO signal (counted as untrained)
markov_contract.point_in_time: bin states, the transition matrix and the signal are all computed from completed information only; a decision at bar t never reads a bar after t and never reads a bin that closes after t
markov_contract.price_state: r = (close - previous bin close) / atr; price_state = 0 (strong up) if r >= price_state_threshold, 1 (mild up) if 0 <= r < threshold, 2 (mild down) if -threshold < r < 0, 3 (strong down) if r <= -threshold
markov_contract.sequence: the decision sequence at base bar t is the last sequence_length COMPLETED bin states; the bin that contains t is excluded until it completes
markov_contract.signal: p_bull = share of the row's transitions landing in states 0..5, p_bear = share landing in 6..11; LONG if p_bull > min_signal_probability and p_bull > p_bear, SHORT if p_bear > min_signal_probability and p_bear > p_bull, otherwise NONE (an exact tie is NONE)
markov_contract.signal_event: a FRESH signal (the signal at the decision bar differs from the signal at the previous base bar) is the entry event; a persistent signal never re-enters after a flatten
markov_contract.sizing: the card-registered tranche rail replaces the source's equal-division sizing: tranche #1 = base_quote x leverage notional at the entry fill; adverse-price scale-ins sit at level_k = entry_fill_price x (1 -/+ spacing_pct x k) for k = 1..10, i.e. at most 11 routine active levels of the 12-tranche rail
markov_contract.state_availability: the state of a bin is visible only at or after that bin's close; a base bar NEVER carries its own bin's state, it carries the most recent COMPLETED bin state (the record's material source-code look-ahead caveat, corrected)
markov_contract.state_basis: the 12-state discretisation is computed on COMPLETED 4h bins aligned to 00:00 UTC and built by resampling the cohort's own 1h bars (O = first open, H = max high, L = min low, C = last close, V = sum volume); every bin must contain exactly 4 base bars
markov_contract.state_index: state = price_state * 3 + volume_state in 0..11; states 0..5 are the BULLISH next-states (price_state 0 or 1, i.e. the next bin's close above this one's) and states 6..11 are the BEARISH next-states
markov_contract.volume_state: vsma_i = mean(V_{i-23..i}) over the rolling 24 completed bins (the current bin included); volume_state = 0 (low) if V_i < volume_low_multiplier * vsma_i, 2 (high) if V_i > volume_high_multiplier * vsma_i, 1 (normal) otherwise (equality is normal)

parameter_domain.markov_contract_status: RESEARCH_DEFINED - the record fixes the MECHANISM (12 states, an empirical transition matrix over state sequences, a probability threshold, a profitability-gated opposite-signal exit) and none of its timing, alignment or training-window detail; this contract is registered once, applied identically to all four cohorts, and never adjusted after seeing results.
parameter_domain.matrix_training_status: RESEARCH_DEFINED - the record requires transition-matrix training to remain strictly isolated from the evaluation window; the registered matrix is an expanding-window point-in-time count structure fed only by transitions whose outcome bin has already completed at the decision bar - never a random split, never a refit on the evaluated slice, nothing from the future of the decision bar.
parameter_domain.min_row_observations_status: PROJECT_PRE_REGISTERED_CONSTANT - the record registers no minimum observation floor for a transition row; the frozen 5 observed transitions (a row with fewer yields NO signal) is a project pre-registration constant, fixed before the first run and never lowered.

parameter_domain.price_state_threshold_status: PROJECT_PRE_REGISTERED_SEARCH_DOMAIN - this axis IS searched over the three registered ATR-relative thresholds (1.0 / 1.5 / 2.0); the record names the parameter and fixes no value, and it is NOT user-fixed (no operator evidence fixes it).

parameter_domain.sequence_length_status: PROJECT_PRE_REGISTERED_SEARCH_DOMAIN - this axis IS searched over the three registered sequence lengths (1 / 2 / 3 completed bin states); the record names the parameter and fixes no value.

registered_family_level_falsification.note: Four FAMILY-level readers registered before the first run, one per record-named falsification item and limitation. They never cull a cohort by themselves; a reader hit must NEVER be recorded as PASS (the runner recommends DEFERRED and the evidence decides the final verdict).

transition-matrix-stability.definition: from the winner's registered state layer over the HISTORICAL window only, split the completed bins into two disjoint halves, build both count matrices, and report (a) the max absolute deviation of p_bull over the sequences that carry at least min_observations_per_half = 10 observed transitions in EACH half (a deviation measured on thinner rows is not evidence of instability and is excluded; the reader needs at least 3 such comparable sequences, otherwise the deviation part reports insufficient_evidence and does not trigger), and (b) the share of the winner's decision bars whose transition row is untrained (fewer than 5 observations); TRIGGERED if the evidence-sufficient max_abs_pbull_deviation > 0.25 or untrained_share > 0.5
transition-matrix-stability.landing: family-level: a hit must NEVER be recorded as PASS
transition-matrix-stability.record_item: the record's falsification item 'verify if transition probabilities are stable over time or if the matrix requires constant refitting'

cohort_survivor_requirements: b) OOS: net_pnl > 0 AND sharpe > 0 for the winner's cell
c) full window: net_pnl > 0 for the winner's cell
d) robustness: the SAME winner cell has net_pnl > 0 in each of fee_2x, funding_2x, entry_delay_1_bar, slippage_2ticks
e) parameter neighbourhood: at least 60% of the winner cell's legal face-adjacent neighbours in the registered joint space agree with the winner's HISTORICAL net-PnL sign
selector_and_disposition.family_disposition_rule: 0 cohort survivors -> verdict REJECT (performance_claimable=false); >=1 survivors -> verdict PASS (band SURVIVOR_FOUND / MULTIPLE_SURVIVORS describes the count only; every survivor is kept and advances); coverage or technical incompleteness -> TECHNICAL_INCOMPLETE. The survivor count is never a reason for performance_claimable=false (contract 9.6 is the only reference).
selector_and_disposition.runner_role: the runner's disposition / verdict_recommendation are RECOMMENDATIONS; the final verdict is written by default into verdict.json per contract 10.7.
selector_and_disposition.selection_protocol: Deterministic, historical window ONLY; OOS must never be used to select parameters.
selection_steps: 1. Sufficiency: if the cohort's best historical case has fewer episodes than gates.min_episodes_is, the cohort is culled with reason insufficient_trades.
2. Eligibility: a case is a candidate iff historical net_pnl > 0 AND historical sharpe > 0 AND historical episodes >= gates.min_episodes_is.
3. If no case is a candidate, the cohort is culled with reason no_qualifying_candidate.

4. Ranking: Sharpe descending, then net_pnl descending, then a fixed lexical tie-break over the REGISTERED INDEX of each axis in the fixed order (window_case, spacing_pct, size_multiplier, breakeven_tp_pct, invalidation_pct). The first case is the cohort winner.
5. The winner's exact strategy+DCA cell is carried unchanged into OOS, full, every robustness grid and the neighbourhood test. No cell may be swapped after OOS has been seen.
